stories.title: C.P. Radhakrishnan elected India's 15th Vice President (9 September)
stories.body: the NDA nominee defeated INDIA bloc's Justice B. Sudershan Reddy 452–300; turnout was 98.2% (767 of 781 eligible MPs) with 752 valid ballots; the election followed Jagdeep Dhankhar's resignation on 21 July.

one_liners: C.P. Radhakrishnan elected India's 15th Vice President (9 September) — the NDA nominee defeated INDIA bloc's Justice B. Sudershan Reddy 452–300
